page.layout: One printed page. Running text in a single column at the right, with a narrow blank column to its left. Below the text an ornament (woodcut headpiece) and a catchword-like signature line at the foot. Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the text column and must be ignored. Marginal annotations in the left margin are too faint and fragmentary to read reliably and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: & veluti communem Ecclesiæ prioris vocem laudarunt, ecce nos istîc vnum sumus : Alioqui quid Deo cum Beliale commercij est, quid luci cum tenebris?

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a woodcut headpiece, not transcribed. The bottom line reads "SECT." in small capitals at the right; the signature "F 4" and the page-foot numeral "84" are faint. Left-margin annotations are illegible at this resolution. Show-through from the reverse page appears throughout the text column and was omitted.
